info.description: Elevate your platform’s trust and security with TRUST's comprehensive Validation & Identity API Suite. It provides instant, accurate validation for email addresses, phone numbers, URLs, IP addresses and IBANs, ensuring your user data is clean and actionable from day one. All endpoints use a solid, fault-tolerant asynchronous queue system: submit your request and receive updates via webhooks (callbacks) or simply poll the resource. It also features a robust Identity and Document Verification which delivers AI-driven, automated verifications.

Callback.description: This is our standardized OpenAPI callback system. It enables the configuration of parameters for receiving notifications about status updates of asynchronous requests to this endpoint.

method.description: Specify the callback method. When set to 'POST', a standard HTTP POST request will be initiated with the Content-Type header set to application/x-www-form-urlencoded. The JSON data will be encoded into a key-value pair named data (customizable using the field parameter) within the request body. If the method is set to 'JSON', a direct HTTP POST request will be made with the Content-Type header set to application/json. The raw JSON data will be directly inserted into the request body without any encoding.

field.description: This parameter works in conjunction with the 'method' parameter set to 'POST'. When provided as a string, it determines the name of the parameter that will be sent in the POST request.

url.description: A valid URL capable of handling POST requests must be entered into this parameter. For endpoints requiring authentication, the 'headers' parameter can be used to specify 'basic auth' or 'bearer auth'. The maximum timeout is 30 seconds. If 'retry' is set, the system will retry up to 'retry' times until a 200 status code is received.

retry.description: The maximum number of attempts is defined by the 'retry' parameter. If the maximum number of attempts is reached without a successful status code (e.g., 200 OK), the request is considered a final failure. A time interval is often introduced between attempts to avoid overloading the server. This interval may increase exponentially with each attempt to reduce the impact on an overloaded server. The 'retry' parameter is configured to retry the request only in case of specific status codes, typically those indicating temporary errors (e.g., 502, 503) or network issues.

headers.description: A collection of HTTP headers to be sent with the request. Each header is defined as a key-value pair. Headers can be used for various purposes, including authentication, content negotiation, and custom metadata.

custom.description: This object can be populated with any additional data you wish to include in the callback response. This data will be accessible within the 'custom' parameter of the callback function. You can use this to store and retrieve any relevant information that you need for your application.

state.description: Defines the status of the request. 'DONE' means the HLR network check is complete.

status.description: The ACTUAL network validity of the phone number via HLR lookup. This is the definitive parameter to check if the number exists and is active. It will remain 'unknown' until the 'state' becomes 'DONE'.

isPossible.description: [FORMAL CHECK ONLY] Indicates if the number length and prefix are theoretically possible for the region. Does NOT mean the number actually exists.

isValid.description: [FORMAL CHECK ONLY] Indicates if the number matches the correct syntax/RegEx for the region. WARNING: A number can be 'isValid: true' but actually be disconnected or inexistent. Rely on the 'status' field for real network validation.

details.description: Additional network details from the supplier (e.g. DELIVERED_TO_HANDSET).

The invalid status will be returned only if the address is technically invalid (incorrect format, nonexistent domain/address or in cases such as greylisting). Lastly, the unknown status will be returned when the provider of the remote server has not responded on time

state.description: Processing state of the request. 'DONE' means processing has finished.

message.description: A generic status message, generally 'Success.', but may contain other information about processing the request or some form of an error notice.

success.description: Was the validation request executed successfully?

valid.description: Does this email address appear valid?

disposable.description: Is this email suspected of belonging to a temporary or disposable mail service? Usually associated with fraudsters and scammers.

smtpScore.description: Validity score of email server's SMTP setup. Range: -1 to 3. Scores above -1 can be associated with a valid email. -1 = invalid email address, 0 = mail server exists, but is rejecting all mail, 1 = mail server exists, but is showing a temporary error, 2 = mail server exists, but accepts all email, 3 = mail server exists and has verified the email address.

overallScore.description: Overall email validity score. Range: 0 to 4. Scores above 1 can be associated with a valid email. 0 = invalid email address, 1 = dns valid, unreachable mail server, 2 = dns valid, temporary mail rejection error, 3 = dns valid, accepts all mail, 4 = dns valid, verified email exists.

firstName.description: Suspected first name based on email. Returns 'CORPORATE' if the email is suspected of being a generic company email. Returns 'UNKNOWN' if the first name was not determinable.

generic.description: Is this email suspected as being a catch all or shared email for a domain? (e.g., 'admin@', 'webmaster@', 'newsletter@', 'sales@', 'contact@', etc.)

common.description: Is this email from common free email providers? (e.g., 'gmail.com', 'yahoo.com', 'hotmail.com', etc.)

dnsValid.description: Does the email's hostname have valid DNS entries? Partial indication of a valid email.

honeypot.description: Is this email believed to be a 'honeypot' or 'SPAM trap'? Bulk mail sent to these emails increases your risk of being blacklisted by large ISPs and ending up in the spam folder.

deliverability.description: How likely is this email to be delivered to the user and land in their mailbox. Values can be 'high', 'medium', or 'low'.

frequentComplainer.description: Indicates if this email frequently unsubscribes from marketing lists or reports spam complaints.

spamTrapScore.description: Intelligent confidence level of the email address being an active SPAM trap. Values can be 'high', 'medium', 'low', or 'none'. We recommend scrubbing emails with a 'high' status, typically for any promotional mailings. This data is meant to provide a more accurate result for the 'frequentComplainer' and 'honeypot' data points.

catchAll.description: Is this email likely to be a 'catch all' where the mail server verifies all emails tested against it as valid? It is difficult to determine if the address is truly valid in these scenarios, since the email's server will not confirm the account's status.

timedOut.description: Did the email verification connection to the mail service provider timeout during the verification? Lookups that timeout with a 'valid' result as false are most likely false and should be not be trusted.

suspect.description: This value indicates if the mail server is currently replying with a temporary mail server error or if the email verification system is unable to verify the email address due to a broken SMTP handshake. This status will also be true for 'catch all' email addresses. If this value is true, then we suspect the 'valid' result may be tainted and there is not a guarantee that the email address is truly valid.

recentAbuse.description: This value will indicate if there has been any recently verified abuse for this email address. Abuse could be a confirmed chargeback, fake signup, compromised device, fake app install, or similar malicious behavior within the past few days.

fraudScore.description: The overall Fraud Score of the user based on the email's reputation and recent behavior. Fraud Scores >= 75 are suspicious, but not necessarily fraudulent.

suggestedDomain.description: Default value is 'N/A'. Indicates if this email's domain should in fact be corrected to a popular mail service. This field is useful for catching user typos. For example, an email address with 'gmai.com', would display a suggested domain of 'gmail.com'.

leaked.description: Was this email address associated with a recent database leak from a third party? Leaked accounts pose a risk as they may have become compromised during a database breach.

sanitizedEmail.description: Sanitized email address with all aliases and masking removed, such as multiple periods for Gmail.com.

identityData.description: An object containing enhanced identity enrichment sourced from highly authoritative data sources. Enriches name, age, and related email addresses, phone numbers, and physical addresses. Each entry represents one person. Each field may return multiple values.

vopResult.description:
The result of the Verification of Payee (VoP) check.
- MATCH: The beneficiary name matches the account holder
- CLOSE_MATCH: The name is a close match to the account holder
- NO_MATCH: The name does not match the account holder
- NOT_APPLICABLE: VoP is not applicable for this IBAN
- ERROR: An error occurred during the verification process
- UNKNOWN: The result is not available (request still in progress or verification not completed)
